hints.title: Target Element Selection
hints.text: Every second, an element can copy its value to its adjacent neighbors in both directions.

hints.title: Circular Distance
hints.text: For any target value, collect all of its 0-indexed positions. The maximum circular gap between consecutive occurrences determines the time needed.

hints.title: Spreading Bound
hints.text: If two adjacent occurrences of x are separated by gap elements, it takes gap // 2 seconds for x to spread into that interval.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash map grouping followed by circular adjacent distance scanning.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating second-by-second array diffusion takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory to index positions enables linear-time resolution.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate diffusion time as half of the maximum circular gap between equal elements.
